blocks.text: A route ErrorBoundary can show a useful message when loading or rendering fails. It keeps the failure from becoming a blank screen.

Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not show private internal error details to visitors. Keep technical logs separate from the visible message.
